Hi,

Thanks for reaching out. It looks like you've sent a system alert that doesn't relate to Aether Career Agent.

If you signed up for our Free plan and need help getting started, I'm happy to walk you through the three-step process: uploading your resume in Resume Studio, setting your target role and location, and running Job Discovery to find tailored openings.

For technical issues with your own infrastructure, you may want to check with your system administrator or review the journalctl logs as suggested in your alert.

If you have questions about Aether Career Agent, just let me know.
